tagline: The world's leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact
hero_kpi_rationale: The 'AI Adoption' KPI is the most relevant as it captures the differentiating integration of agent AI (Agents for Good) into NGO workflows, a key lever for growth and customer loyalty in their Intelligence for Good strategy.

kpis.name: AI Feature Adoption
kpis.explanation: More than half of Raiser's Edge NXT customers use AI features to identify potential donors.
kpis.description: Adoption of AI features, particularly for donor identification, is a key indicator of successful AI integration into products.
kpis.signal: More than half of customers adopt AI for prospecting

kpis.name: Recurring Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Approximately 64% of total revenue comes from recurring contracts related to cloud software.
kpis.description: The majority of revenue comes from recurring software contracts, providing stable financial visibility.
kpis.signal: Two-thirds of revenue is recurring and predictable

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated operating margin, improved by efficiency gains and internal AI.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves due to cost optimization, migration to the cloud, and internal AI-driven automation.
kpis.signal: Continuous improvement driven by operational efficiency

kpis.name: R&D (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Blackbaud maintains a high level of R&D investment to strengthen its AI capabilities and product interconnectivity.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in software innovation and AI

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees worldwide, with expansion of the center in India.
kpis.description: Headcount decreases slightly following optimizations and the transition to the global capability center in India (GCC).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue, driven by software and transactional services.
kpis.description: Revenue grows due to customer retention, renewals, and cross-selling.
kpis.signal: Stable growth driven by recurring contracts

kpis.name: Average Contract Duration
kpis.explanation: More than 20% of renewing customers have opted for contracts of 4 years or longer.
kpis.description: Lengthening of contracts (3-year standard, more than 20% at 4+ years) improves visibility into future revenue.
kpis.signal: Extension of contract duration for greater visibility

kpis.name: Transactional Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in transactional revenue driven by donations, fundraising, and tuition fees.
kpis.description: Transactional revenue increases due to adoption of digital payments and pricing optimization initiatives.
kpis.signal: Growth sustained by online donation behavior

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $0.243 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2020).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.115 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Dependence on AI for Growth
risks.score_rationale: Central position in strategy (foundational), strong language (foundational to driving operating leverage). The entire growth strategy relies on successful AI adoption, with products such as Agents for Good. Technology category heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Data Security Risk
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of expenses related to a Security Incident, with past costs of $10.6M. The company handles sensitive data, amplifying potential impact. Continuous presence in risks.

risks.title: Concentration of Renewals in 2026
risks.score_rationale: 40% of contracts to be renewed in 2026, with an amount 40% higher than in 2025. The company explicitly warns of a higher risk of churn dollars. Cyclical but significant risk.

risks.title: Dependence on Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Transactional revenue (34%) depends on donations, influenced by economic conditions. Explicit mention of the impact of macroeconomic conditions on donation behavior. Recurring and well-documented risk.

risks.title: Costs and Complexity of India Transition
risks.score_rationale: Forecasted costs of $6M to $8M in 2026 for the transition to the GCC in India. Mention of complex workforce strategy with roles being transferred. High operational risk.

risks.title: Intensifying Technological Competition
risks.score_rationale: Although not directly stated, positioning in AI within a growing sector attracts competitors. The constant need for innovation to maintain leadership implies a high competitive risk, implicit but critical.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Mention of a $2.8M impact related to foreign exchange in 2025. Present in results, but no alarmist language. Moderate weighting as partially realized already.

ai_positioning.summary: AI is at the core of Blackbaud's long-term strategy. The company integrates AI in a disciplined manner across its products, platform, and internal operations, considered fundamental to operational leverage and sustainable growth. Agents for Good, the generative AI suite launched in late 2025, is a major illustration.
evidence: More than half of Raiser's Edge NXT customers adopt AI features for donor identification
Launch of Agents for Good in October 2025 to automate complex workflows
Integration of ML and AI capabilities into products through the Intelligence for Good initiative
Internal adoption of AI tools to improve productivity in R&D, customer support, and administrative functions
